notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.
